title: Building Dinotopia in Lego
content: Seattle area builderShawn Snyderrecreated the saurian-themed architecture of Dinotopia in Lego bricks.The gold trimmed details of the pediment use dinosaur-shaped motifs, and pterosaur finials hover over the towers.The dinosaur firefighting rig was based on a page spread fromDinotopia: Journey To Chandara.The firefighter has his tools mounted on the side of his Triceratops saddle, with the hose reel right behind him.More Lego creations on the siteBrothers BrickThanks, Michael Lynch
